sloka: कथं च नाम ते राजन् लोकानाक्रम्य तेजसा ।नारीचौर्यमिदं क्षुद्रं कृतं शौण्डीर्यमानिना ।। ६.११४.६८ ।।
transliteration: kathaṁ ca nāma te rājan lokānākramya tejasā ।nārīcauryamidaṁ kṣudraṁ kṛtaṁ śauṇḍīryamāninā ।। 6.114.68 ।।

translations.english: "King! 'The tears of noble women should not fall on the earth's surface' is a popular saying. This calamity is truly a result to you in return."
